name: naming
description: Generates and evaluates fresh name candidates for an identifier, file, module, skill, repo, or domain term (naming:name-it-better). It distills a context brief, runs blind fresh-context generators from distinct lenses (responsibility-literal, moment-of-use, domain-lore), and scores a shortlist against the org's naming criteria. The human always picks; it never locks a name. An optional tournament mode adds elimination rounds with independent judges for high-stakes names.
